diagnosis: The Jest distributed coverage endpoint exposes complete source maps, uncovered proprietary lines, and environment summaries for any given runId. It validates that the requester has a staging token, but never checks if the caller is authorized for the project associated with runId. In shared staging clusters, an attacker can access source code representations and proprietary algorithms belonging to other development teams.
